boundaryGate.question: After Alembic commit 76358d9ddbdf3ab9c316718aa841367e4c6f79d5, does the final P4 real-machine panorama dashboard/scope/rescan gate pass, including BiliDili using local Qwen/Ollama embedding rather than DeepSeek embedding fallback?
boundaryGate.objectBoundary: 真实 AlembicWorkspace panorama/dashboard/API scope gate plus真实 BiliDili projectRoot dashboard/API/rescan non-regression. Subject roots are the configured AlembicWorkspace space and BiliDili projectRoot only; no sandbox substitute for the real P4 gate.
controllerSelfChecks: Controller accepted Alembic embedding runtime bridge repair after raw evidence review and reran targeted BootstrapRuntimeSettings tests, build:check, boundary lints, touched-file biome, npm lint, and diff checks.
Controller confirmed prior P4 Test had already passed panorama scope Gate 1/2 and rescan terminal proof shape but blocked on DeepSeek embedding fallback.
Controller added this rerun package only after accepting Alembic commit 76358d9ddbdf3ab9c316718aa841367e4c6f79d5.
realScenarioConditions: Use true BiliDili projectRoot for Gate 2 and Gate 3; do not substitute a fixture or AlembicWorkspace-only run.
Use the existing configured generation/embedding split: DeepSeek for generation and local Qwen/Ollama for embedding. Do not change provider configuration to make the test pass.
Restart or relaunch the Alembic runtime as needed so the accepted Alembic commit and runtime env bridge are active before rescan.
Run the same P4 panorama/dashboard/API scope checks as prior final gate reruns, then run one scoped BiliDili /api/v1/jobs/rescan terminal observation.
successMeans: AlembicWorkspace panorama 4 tabs/API show only the configured workspace members and no BiliDili leakage.
BiliDili own projectRoot dashboard/API remains scoped to BiliDili and does not show AlembicWorkspace members.
BiliDili scoped rescan produces terminal completed job evidence with public job/events/display snapshot proof and no snapshot table deletion/full rebuild/preclean outside allowed data roots.

Runtime/log evidence shows effective embedding provider is local Qwen/Ollama, with ALEMBIC_EMBED_PROVIDER=ollama and qwen3-embedding model or equivalent non-secret proof; logs do not show DeepSeek embedding fallback or `[deepseek] embed failed`.
failureMeans: Any AlembicWorkspace/BiliDili scope leakage means P4 remains blocked and should return to owning source repository with raw evidence.
Any rescan terminal/status/events/display proof gap means P4 remains blocked and should return with the exact public API/log evidence gap.
Any DeepSeek embedding fallback or `[deepseek] embed failed` evidence after the accepted bridge repair means P4 remains blocked and should return to Alembic with runtime/env/log evidence.
Any destructive data-root/snapshot-table side effect blocks acceptance regardless of other passing checks.
cannotConclude: Passing this test does not authorize push/tag/release/version bump.
Passing this test does not prove per-module coverage direct alignment; CG-E project-level degradation remains as accepted earlier.
Passing a partial dashboard endpoint probe alone does not close P4 unless BiliDili rescan terminal and embedding-provider evidence are also present.
Recipe count growth, minNewRecipes, or quota movement alone cannot substitute for terminal job/status/events/display evidence.
stopConditions: Stop and return blocked if runtime still uses DeepSeek for embedding after restart with accepted commit.
Stop and return blocked if project root identity is ambiguous or the test cannot prove it used true BiliDili.
Stop and return blocked before destructive cleanup or provider mutation would be needed to continue.
Stop and return blocked if required public job/status/events/display evidence cannot be collected.

evidenceRequired: AlembicWorkspace panorama/API/UI 4-tab evidence and member list with no BiliDili leakage.
BiliDili dashboard/API evidence showing no AlembicWorkspace leakage.
Runtime process restart/health evidence and non-secret effective embedding summary showing local Qwen/Ollama path.
BiliDili rescan request/job id/status/events/display terminal evidence; final status must be completed or failure must include blocker details.
Log excerpt summary proving no `[deepseek] embed failed` or DeepSeek embedding fallback during embedding path.
Read-only snapshot-table before/after summary for project_context_file_snapshots/bootstrap_snapshots or equivalent no-deletion evidence.
TargetResultEnvelope status completed only if all gates pass; otherwise blocked with exact raw evidence and next owner.
allowedOperations: Read state root, accepted target evidence, Test/Alembic/AlembicDashboard repository rules, and configured real project roots.
Restart/relaunch local Alembic runtime/dashboard processes as needed for observation.
Run HTTP/API probes, UI/dashboard checks, log inspection, non-secret env/effective-config summaries, and SQLite read-only snapshot-table checks.
Run one scoped BiliDili rescan through the public jobs/rescan path and monitor terminal public job/status/events/display outputs.
forbiddenOperations: Do not edit source code, dashboard code, or provider configuration.
Do not push, tag, release, change versions, or open branches.
Do not delete true project data roots, preclean the target data to force success, or remove snapshot tables.
Do not write real thread ids to tracked docs or backfill text.
